lead: Sanath Jayasuriya is a Sri Lankan cricketer, born on 30 June 1969 in Matara.
As of 2026, he is 57 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has represented Sri Lanka national cricket team and Bloomfield Cricket and Athletic Club and has held the office of Member of the Parliament of Sri Lanka.
The sections that follow break down Sanath Jayasuriya's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Sanath Jayasuriya — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists cricketer, politician and athlete as his occupations.

On the team sheet, Sanath has been associated with Sri Lanka national cricket team (from 1991 to 2007), Bloomfield Cricket and Athletic Club, Somerset (from 2005 to 2005), Marylebone Cricket Club (from 2007 to 2007), Lancashire (from 2007 to 2007), Warwickshire (from 2008 to 2008), Mumbai Indians (from 2008 to 2010) and Worcestershire (from 2010 to 2010).
He has held the following offices: Member of the Parliament of Sri Lanka (2010–2015). He is affiliated with United People's Freedom Alliance.
